content.text: Of the variations, the only one that is intentional is:
fcrepo.modeshape.configuration (expects a path prefixed by either "file:" or "classpath:")
...due to ModeShape expectations.

Additionally, the minter (spring) configuration file can be overriden by setting fcrepo.minter.config, which gives three different types of "configuration" formats: config, configuration and cache_configuration. It would be nice to standardize these.
Plus, I have a use case for being able to override the activemq configuration. Should that be "fcrepo.activemq.configuration"?
"fcrepo.activemq.configuration" aligns with the more frequent use of "configuration" vs. "config". That being the case, "fcrepo.minter.config" should also change to "fcrepo.minter.configuration".

Would it make sense to put all of the configurable properties into a central fcrepo.properties file? Then, each property could be overridden as in the current setup, but there would be a much cleaner way of managing these values.
, A central properties file which provides the values (and current defaults) from which the other configuration files ultimately get there values would be cleaner, indeed.
OK, I'm working on a PR for this – should be ready for review on 1/20 or 1/21
Addressed with this PR:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/691
The basic conventions I adopted were:
prefix everything with fcrepo
for spring-related configuration, prefix with fcrepo.spring
for infinispan-related configuration, use fcrepo.ispn
for infinispan caches, use cache (instead of CacheDirPath)
for all other directories, use directory
for configuration files, use configuration
A detailed list of changes are listed with the pull request
I like your suggestion of changing the configuration elements, 'log.fcrepo.' to 'fcrepo.log.*'.
Please do that and we can move this ticket through.
I changed the instances of log.fcrepo.* to fcrepo.log.* and pushed a new commit to the PR
, I have not yet completed this review, but wanted to give you a heads up that there appear to be other "
repository
.json" files in the codebase that are not included in this PR... possibly the same with other logback and configuration files. Also, the other supported projects will need updates as well:
https://github.com/fcrepo4
There are five repository.json files that weren't touched. For four of these, this makes sense:
./fcrepo-integration-ldp/src/test/resources/test_repository.json
./fcrepo-integration-rdf/src/test/resources/test_repository.json
./fcrepo-jms/src/test/resources/config/testing/repository.json
./fcrepo-kernel-impl/src/test/resources/config/testing/repository.json
(There are no ${property.value:default} style property values in those files).
in: ./fcrepo-connector-file/src/test/resources/config/testing/repository.json, however,
there are three properties:
fcrepo.test.dir1
fcrepo.test.dir2
fcrepo.test.properties.dir
I'll add an additional commit to normalize these. I'll also see if I can't find other files that I missed earlier.
Thanks,
. Will you also be able to update the other projects in the fcrepo4 GitHub organization?
yes, by the end of the week. It will be earlier, if we don't lose power in tomorrow's blizzard.
It looks like the following files use the test.port property set in pom.xml:
./fcrepo-transform/src/test/resources/spring-test/test-container.xml
./fcrepo-mint/src/test/resources/test-container.xml
./fcrepo-integration-rdf/src/test/resources/spring-test/test-container.xml
./fcrepo-integration-ldp/src/test/resources/spring-test/test-container.xml
./fcrepo-http-api/src/test/resources/spring-test/test-container.xml
I could change these to fcrepo.test.port for the sake of consistency. Thoughts?
this test: ./fcrepo-webapp/src/test/java/org/fcrepo/integration/AbstractResourceIT.java defines a test.context.path property. I would like to change it to fcrepo.test.context.path.

Also, this test: ./fcrepo-http-api/src/test/java/org/fcrepo/integration/http/api/FedoraCrudConcurrentIT.java uses a property with this value: RUN_TEST_CRUD_CONCURRENT. I am thinking of changing this to fcrepo.test.http.concurrent (or fcrepo.test.crud.concurrent, though I'm inclined toward the former)
from ./fcrepo-http-api/src/main/java/org/fcrepo/http/api/FedoraHttpConfiguration.java:
${fcrepo.http.ldp.putRequiresIfMatch:false}
I am inclined to keep this unchanged. Thoughts?
from ./fcrepo-kernel-impl/src/main/java/org/fcrepo/kernel/impl/TransactionImpl.java

the property: fcrepo4.tx.timeout is defined. I am thinking that I will change this to fcrepo.transactions.timeout (to bring it in line with fcrepo.spring.transactions.configuration and also to eliminate the more arcane tx abbreviation)
From ./fcrepo-configs/src/main/resources/config/jgroups-fcrepo-tcp.xml there are a number of jgroups.* configuration values:
${jgroups.tcp.address:0.0.0.0}
${jgroups.tcp.port:7800}
${jgroups.tcpping.initial_hosts:localhost[7800]}
I'm not entirely sure what to do with these – should they be prefixed with fcrepo? Should they be left alone?

We may as well get the pain over with (including the propagating updates to the other projects in fcrepo4 GitHub). All of your suggestions look good, including leaving the jgroups configuration values unchanged.
I just submitted a new commit to this PR with these additional changes.
I just submitted a similar PR for fcrepo-message-consumer:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo-message-consumer/pull/69

There were two configuration values that I did not change: fcrepo.port and fcrepo.context, both defined in ./fcrepo-message-consumer-webapp/pom.xml but not used anywhere else. I suspect that they could be removed, but I am not 100% sure about that.
An analogous PR for fcrepo-module-auth-rbacl is here:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo-module-auth-rbacl/pull/8

@awoods the auth-xacml module is a little tricky – when the spring configuration uses test.port, the code builds fine. However, when it is changed to fcrepo.test.port, it fails. So I left that value unchanged. Otherwise, the PR is here:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo-module-auth-xacml/pull/29
, auth-xacml depends on auth-rbacl. Once I pulled down and built your PRs for fcrepo4 and auth-rbacl, the change to fcrepo.test.port in auth-xacml worked (was required).
I will update your auth-xacml PR.
, I agree, the configuration elements in fcrepo-message-consumer-webapp/pom.xml: fcrepo.port and fcrepo.context can be removed. I will update your PR.
@awoods, thanks. I didn't know that auth-xacml had a dependency on auth-rbacl, but that makes sense. (I had only run mvn clean verify, instead of mvn install). And thanks for modifying the PRs

Is there a wiki page that documents these changes?  It would be nice to have a quick guide for people who wanted to update older repos.
I believe the configuration items are mostly represented on this page:
https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FEDORA4x/Application+Configuration
But that page doesn't include all of the configuration options (esp. the spring overrides)

The fcrepo configuration values passed into the JVM follow inconsistent conventions, including CamelCase, hyphens, underscores and period delimiters. Also, the values of these configuration parameters expect different formats. For example:
fcrepo.home (expects a regular path)
fcrepo.modeshape.configuration (expects a path prefixed by either "file:" or "classpath:")
fcrepo.ispn.repo.CacheDirPath (uses camelCase, expects a regular path)
fcrepo.binary-store-path (uses hyphens ? and expects a regular path)
fcrepo.activemq.dir (regular path)
fcrepo.infinispan.cache_configuration (why is this not fcrepo.ispn.*? and why the underscore?)
Are there reasons why there is such a diversity of formats?
